title: 📢 ITR Filing Due Date Extended to 15th September 2026
html:
The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has officially extended the due date for filing Income Tax Returns for Assessment Year 2026-27.

CategoryOriginal Due DateRevised Due Date
Non-Audit Taxpayers u/s 139(1)31st July 202615th September 2026
Tax Audit Cases u/s 44AB31st October 2026No Change

Official Notification:

Please update all your non-audit clients about this extension and revise filing schedules accordingly.

🔗 Visit Income Tax Portal for more details

title: 📋 GST Portal Scheduled Maintenance — 5th August
body:
The GST portal will be under scheduled maintenance on 5th August 2026 from 12:00 AM to 6:00 AM IST.

During this window, the following services will be temporarily unavailable:
• GSTR-1 Filing
• GSTR-3B Filing
• GSTR-9 Annual Return
• E-Way Bill Generation

Please plan your filings accordingly and complete any pending submissions before the maintenance window.
